    Specialist stroke care and length of hospital stay

    Source: R/data.R
    stroke_los.Rd

    Mean length of hospital stay (days) for patients who received specialist stroke unit care (group 1) or conventional care (group 2) in nine trials. A standard example for standardised mean differences.

    Usage

    stroke_los

    Format

    A tibble with 9 rows and 8 columns:

    study

    Study number.

    source

    Trial site and patient group.

    n1, m1, sd1

    Sample size, mean and standard deviation of length of stay with specialist care.

    n2, m2, sd2

    Sample size, mean and standard deviation of length of stay with conventional care.

    Source

    Normand, S.-L. T. (1999). Meta-analysis: formulating, evaluating, combining, and reporting. Statistics in Medicine, 18(3), 321-359. doi:10.1002/(SICI)1097-0258(19990215)18:3<321::AID-SIM28>3.0.CO;2-P

    Values cross-checked against dat.normand1999 in the 'metadat' package.

    Examples

    meta_effect_size(stroke_los, "SMD",
  m1 = m1, sd1 = sd1, n1 = n1, m2 = m2, sd2 = sd2, n2 = n2)
